text:
lauren: Hey team — quick emergency: our nanny canceled and I need to take two days next week to care for my toddler. What options do I have for short-notice paid time, childcare reimbursement, and coverage for my weekly syncs?

emily: Oh no, hope all is okay. For short-notice family care, you can use Emergency Dependent Care (EDC) up to 3 days paid per rolling 12 months. Please file the EDC form at https://redwood.hr/leave -> select 'Emergency Dependent Care' and include a short note.

lauren: Great — do I need manager sign-off? My manager's away but Claire can cover calendar blocks.

emily: Manager acknowledgement is required but People Ops can provisionally approve if the manager is unavailable. Please CC Claire in the form and well mark it "provisionally approved" until your manager confirms.

claire: I can cover syncs on Tues/Wed. Lauren, ping me your meeting notes and I'll run the standup. Also we can move the all-hands task list.

lauren: Thanks Claire. One more: can Redwood reimburse a last-minute daycare booking or an emergency babysitter fee?

emily: Yes, emergency childcare costs are eligible up to $200/day (policy cap). Submit receipts at https://redwood.hr/expenses with subject "EDC - emergency childcare" and attach the EDC approval. For large or recurring short-notice needs we'll discuss exceptions.

ryan: Quick ops note: If youre oncall those two days we need a handoff. I can take pager monitoring and urgent triage if you share the credentials and a 15min run-through.

lauren: I'm not scheduled for heavy oncall but there is an afternoon pager window Wed. I'll transfer creds and drop a short runbook in the doc.

payroll-bot: Automated: EDC claims processed after People Ops approval. Reimbursements hit next payroll cycle if submitted by the payroll cutoff. For urgent reimbursement, mark as "expedite" in the expense form and People Ops will route for ad-hoc payment.

lauren: About childcare vendor booking fees — can Redwood pay the agency deposit upfront? I need to secure a temporary sitter and they request a non-refundable deposit.

emily: We can issue an advance for agency deposits for documented emergency care. Submit a reimbursement with "advance requested" and indicate amount. People Ops will coordinate with Finance for an advance payment; include vendor invoice and booking terms.

lauren: Any tax implications I should expect for the advance or reimbursement?

emily: Emergency childcare reimbursements under the EDC policy are treated as taxable income. Payroll will report on the paystub and end-of-year forms. If the company issues an advance that is later reconciled with receipts, the net amount remains taxable. Payroll can provide exact withholding estimates on request.

claire: Facilities question: Lauren left a desk phone and headset at HQ; if she needs to work from home one day and return gear later, is pickup/drop allowed?

facilities-bot: Automated: For short-term equipment transfers, open a ticket at https://redwood.tools/facilities choose "temporary equipment transfer". We can ship headsets or accept returns. Shipping outside the country requires additional approvals. Expect 2 business days for shipping.

lauren: I might need a spare laptop charger shipped overnight to my home. Will facilities cover shipping?

emily: Facilities covers overnight shipping for business-critical gear once People Ops approves emergency leave. File the facilities ticket and tag it with your EDC case number. We'll expedite.

recruiting: If you need a temporary contractor to keep your project velocity, submit a Backfill Request with "duration=2_weeks" and skills. Talent has a bench for rapid 2-week coverage; earliest placement ~5 business days. For shorter windows we recommend internal coverage first.

lauren: I'll try internal coverage first but submitting backfill in case needed. Thanks all — filing EDC form now and will add Claire to the calendar blocks.

emily: Adding a checklist in a DM: 1) submit EDC form, 2) tag Claire as provisional approver, 3) expense receipts or advance request, 4) facilities ticket if you need gear shipped, 5) if backfill needed, tag recruiting. We'll expedite the payroll step if you request "expedite". Take care! :heart:
